baseline.description: A perturbation changes expression by the sum of its genes' single-gene changes in training (additive model).

lineage.hypothesis: Warm start: the best model of run norman_control_replogle_w4_r0 (EXP_0198, visible 0.6423) is the starting point of this run.
The squared sign-flipped external direct delta of the perturbation's targets captures nonlinear amplification for large external effects, improving prediction.
Applying a random nonlinear transformation (e.g., sin of scaled external direct delta) to the external_direct feature captures non-linear effects and may improve predictions.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=100 for the best model (EXP_0065).
The product of the ranks of the two targets' external Replogle delta magnitudes adds predictive power.
Removing prior_network_edge_e8 from the current best feature set does not decrease performance and may reduce noise.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=100 for the best model (EXP_0110).
A low-dimensional random projection of the external Replogle delta vector for each perturbation captures a broader external response signature that is predictive of the perturbation effect on gene g.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=100 for the best model (EXP_0161).
The number of shared gene sets (pathways) containing both the perturbation target(s) and gene g predicts delta.
The product of the sign-flipped external deltas of the two targets in a pair perturbation captures synergistic or antagonistic effects beyond additive sums.
Multiplying the additive single-gene response by the sign-flipped external delta product for pairs captures non-additive interactions that improve prediction.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=100 for the best model (EXP_0198).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=300 for the best model (EXP_0209).
A different random projection of the external delta vector captures complementary information to the existing external_random_projection_multicomp_e15_e161.
The product of gene g's control mean expression and the external direct delta of the perturbation is predictive.
Tuning the ridge regularization strength alpha on the current best feature set (EXP_0282) yields a better Pearson delta than the default alpha=100. [sweep alpha_grid=1000]
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=1000 for the best model (EXP_0309).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=3000 for the best model (EXP_0314).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=9000 for the best model (EXP_0333).
Add external_direct_replogle2022_k562_e16_e20 to the best model (EXP_0368): it helped elsewhere and the best model lacks it.
Drop external_direct_sin_transform_e65 from the best model (EXP_0386) to test whether it still earns its place.
Drop external_direct_replogle2022_k562_e16 from the best model (EXP_0434) to test whether it still earns its place.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=27000 for the best model (EXP_0453).
The optimal ridge penalty may shift when adding the weighted gene set feature; sweeping alpha will fine-tune regularization. [sweep alpha_grid=20000]
Add partial_corr_target_output_e28 to the best model (EXP_0506) although it did not help where it was first tried.
Drop pair_external_rank_product_e85 from the best model (EXP_0630) to test whether it still earns its place.

most_useful_features.description: Sum over the perturbation's target genes of the mean training delta of each target's single-gene perturbation, excluding the current perturbation from training data.
Sum of sign-flipped Replogle 2022 K562 CRISPRi screen deltas of the perturbation's target gene(s), broadcast to all genes.
Control-cell Pearson co-expression of the perturbation target(s) with each gene g.

Product of the additive single-gene response and the sign-flipped external Replogle2022_K562 delta: for pairs, the product with the pairwise external delta product; for singles, the product with the external direct delta.
Sine of the scaled external direct delta feature.
Sine transform of the external direct Replogle2022 K562 delta feature.
Square of the sum of sign-flipped external direct deltas of the perturbation's targets.
Product of ranks (by absolute value) of the sign-flipped external Replogle2022_K562 deltas of the two targets in a pair perturbation; 0 for single-gene perturbations.
Product of gene g's control mean expression and the sum of sign-flipped external Replogle2022_K562 deltas of perturbation p's targets.
A low-dimensional random projection of the sign-flipped external Replogle delta vector for the perturbation's target(s), using a different random seed.
